cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M
# worst-ish config
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,
 "rules":[{"id":i,"class":65535,"priority":i,"ranges":[[-2048,-2048]]*32} for i in range(100)],
 "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}
v=M.validate_config(cfg)
prog=M.program_from_config(v)
eng=M.Engine(prog)
F=100
for fid in range(F):
    eng.handle({"op":"open","flow":fid,"time":0}, True if fid==0 else False)
# give each 40 packets
t=0
pk=[]
for step in range(40):
    t+=1
    for fid in range(F):
        pk.append({"flow":fid,"time":t,"source":step%2,"length":2048})
    # chunk limit 1024; F=100 so fine
eng.handle({"op":"chunk","packets":pk}, False)
cp=eng._checkpoint()
s=json.dumps(cp,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode('ascii')
print("F",len(eng.flows),"size",len(s),"budget",512+8192*len(eng.flows))
PYEOF
